blurb: Guests rent electric boats to cruise Lake Union at their own pace, with options for guided GPS audio tours and interactive scavenger hunts. Boats accommodate various group sizes and are easy to drive with a safety orientation. Catering and beverage options are available for onboard enjoyment.
extraNote: Strict 48-hour cancellation policy; no refund for same-day cancellations · Full refund if manager deems weather unsafe at departure time · $6 booking fee per boat per reservation · Payment due in full prior to cruise; deposit required at booking · Open rain or shine; only close for dangerous weather · Office located at the bottom of the staircase from the front door and at the bottom of the dock ramp on the side of the building at 2046 Westlake Ave N, Seattle, WA 98109.
